recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-5372; any future desire for more document examples should be handled as a separate issue.
issue_request: FHIR-5372 was a Published FHIR-core Jan 2015 ballot comment with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It reported that the first documents-page "Example Document" XML/JSON links returned 404s and accepted deleting that first bullet while retaining the valid discharge-summary example.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN r4200, imported as git commit af75022bd95ef6f41bb25ef26a864e8283fce8fd, whose subject says it deleted the first "Example Document" bullet from source/documents.html.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists documents.html in the current Exchange page hierarchy, so source/documents.html is in current build/navigation scope. Current source/documents.html contains only the discharge-summary example in the examples list, and source searches found no remaining obsolete query-example/document-example links on that page. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already matches the Jira resolution by omitting the broken first example bullet and keeping the discharge-summary XML/JSON example.
